entry.title: [確認しておく] npm: TinyMCE Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability using media plugin `data-mce-object` serialization (HIGH)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：確認しておく TinyMCEのmediaプラグインでXSS。HIGH
→ TinyMCE 8.9.3または7.9.4に更新

tinymce >= 8.5.1, < 8.9.3 → 8.9.3, TinyMCE >= 8.5.1, < 8.9.3 → 8.9.3, tinymce/tinymce >= 8.5.1, < 8.9.3 → 8.9.3, tinymce = 7.9.3 → 7.9.4, TinyMCE = 7.9.3 → 7.9.4, tinymce/tinymce = 7.9.3 → 7.9.4

CVE-2026-116675
